headline: Brazil Restarts Basin Environmental Assessments and Pelotas Studies
summary: The Brazilian government modernized environmental assessment procedures for sedimentary basins and initiated studies for new oil and gas blocks in Pelotas.
why: Environmental licensing updates and exploratory block studies dictate future oil and gas auction schedules and capital allocation for energy majors in Brazil.

impacts.name: Oil & Gas
impacts.why: Streamlined environmental procedures pave the way for offshore exploration.
